DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の防犯について、お聞きになりたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about preventing bicycle theft?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 後輪の錠だけ使っています。二つ付けるとよいと聞きましたが、もう一つはどこに付けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 後輪錠に追加する錠の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I only use the rear-wheel lock. I heard it is good to use two locks, but where should I attach the other one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask where to attach an additional lock alongside the rear-wheel lock. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 見本の自転車とワイヤー錠でご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will explain using this sample bicycle and cable lock.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 見本を見たいです。自分のは前輪を外せる型なので、前輪だけに付ければ足りるのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 脱着前輪の自転車と前輪だけの施錠への疑問を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I would like to see the example. My bicycle has a removable front wheel, so I am unsure whether locking only the front wheel is enough.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your front wheel is removable and ask whether locking just that wheel is sufficient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: フレームとの組合せも含めてご案内します。外せる部品だけでは本体を残せません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will also explain how to include the frame. Securing only removable parts will not keep the bicycle itself in place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車体のこの部分も通すのですね。私のワイヤーは短いので、この通し方ができるか帰って試します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: フレームを通す方法と自宅で長さを試す方針を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I pass it through this part of the frame too. My cable is short, so I will try this method at home to see whether it reaches.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss passing the lock through the frame and checking the cable length at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 固定物へ付ける場合は、その場所の利用条件もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you attach it to a fixed object, please also check the rules for using that location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 駐輪場では指定の金具があるので、そこの表示を見ます。歩道の柵へ勝手に付けるつもりはありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定金具の条件を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bicycle parking area has designated fittings, so I will read the sign there. I do not intend to attach it to a sidewalk fence without permission.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the rules for the designated fittings. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 鍵は二本になります。持ち出す前にそろえておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You will have two keys. Please have both ready before taking your bicycle out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二本を同じ鍵束へ付けます。見本の図をもらって、自分の車体で長さを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二本の鍵をまとめ図で自車の適合を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put both on the same key ring. I will take the sample diagram and check the length on my own bicycle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep both keys together and use the diagram to check the fit on your bicycle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 図をお持ちください。ご参加ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the diagram. Thank you for participating. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お返事の封筒でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this an envelope for a reply?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 商品アンケートの返信封筒です。切手の所に印刷があるので、切手を買う必要があるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 返信封筒の印刷から切手購入要否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a reply envelope for a product survey. There is printing where the stamp goes, so I would like to ask whether I need to buy a stamp.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the printing on the reply envelope means you need to buy a stamp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の表示を拝見します。こちらは料金受取人払とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at the marking. It says that postage is paid by the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この文字ですね。自分が窓口で送料を払うのではなく、相手が払う扱いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 料金受取人払の文字と相手負担を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: These words here, correct? Does this mean the recipient pays, rather than me paying postage at the counter?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the recipient-paid postage marking and who pays. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この封筒の取扱いを確認しました。指定された返信を入れて、切手なしで出せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: I have checked how this envelope is handled. You can put the specified reply inside and send it without a stamp.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: アンケートの用紙一枚を入れました。宛名は印刷済みですが、差出人を書く所はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: アンケート一枚を入れ差出人記入位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have put one survey sheet inside. The recipient's address is printed, but where should I write the sender's details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have enclosed one survey sheet and ask where to write the sender's details. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 裏面のこちらへ書けます。中身はほかにございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can write them here on the back. Is there anything else inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 用紙だけです。裏に自分の住所と名前も書きました。ふたを閉じて出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙のみと裏面住所氏名記入後の封緘を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Just the sheet. I have also written my address and name on the back. I will seal the flap and send it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that only the sheet is enclosed and that you will seal it after writing your address and name on the back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付できます。表示の上へテープをかぶせないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can accept it. Please do not put tape over the marking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ふたの部分だけ留めました。印刷された表示が読めるままで、この返信をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示を隠さない封緘後に返信差出しを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have secured only the flap. The printed marking is still readable; please send this reply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to send the reply after sealing it without hiding the marking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お預かりします。ご利用ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take it. Thank you for using our service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座振替のご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to discuss a direct debit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今月だけ学費の引落しが多くなります。通知に二つの金額があって、口座へいくら用意するか整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 臨時増額学費の二金額と入金準備を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My school fees debit will be higher just this month. The notice lists two amounts, and I would like to work out how much to have in the account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the two amounts for this month's increased school fees and preparing a deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引落し日と、通知の金額を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the debit date and the amounts on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 授業料三万円と教材費八千円で、同じ十五日です。通常は三万円だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 十五日の授業料教材費と通常額を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is 30,000 yen tuition and 8,000 yen for materials, both on the 15th. Normally it is just 30,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State the tuition and materials fees due on the 15th and the usual amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 合計は三万八千円です。そのほかの引落しもお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The total is 38,000 yen. Please take other direct debits into account as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ日に家賃もあります。今の残高との差額を計算したいので、通帳を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同日家賃も含め残高との差を計算したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: My rent is also due on the same day. I will check my bankbook to calculate the difference from my current balance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to calculate the difference from your balance, including rent due that day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通帳に未記帳の取引があれば、記帳してからご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: If any transactions have not been printed in your bankbook, please update it before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 記帳します。家賃を加えると必要額が分かったので、不足分を今日入金したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記帳後不足額の入金を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will update it. Adding the rent has shown me how much I need, so I would like to deposit the shortfall today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Offer to deposit the shortfall after updating your bankbook. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入金の窓口をご案内します。引落しの時点で足りるようご準備ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will show you the deposit counter. Please ensure there is enough in the account when the debit occurs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 学費の二項目を合計し、家賃も加えました。入金後の残高を見て、用意した金額を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二項目と家賃の合計及び入金後残高確認を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have totaled the two school fee items and added the rent. I will check the balance after depositing to confirm that I have prepared the right amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mention the total of both fees and rent, and checking your balance after the deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、記帳機と入金窓口へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please go to the bankbook updating machine and the deposit counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: コーヒー豆は、そのままお持ち帰りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Will you be taking the coffee beans home whole?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家にミルがないので、買う豆を挽いてもらいたいです。紙のフィルターで淹れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自宅ミルなしと紙フィルター用の挽き依頼をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not have a grinder at home, so I would like the beans I buy to be ground. I brew with a paper filter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no grinder and request grinding for a paper filter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この売場で購入する豆はお挽きできます。粗さは淹れ方に合わせてお伺いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can grind beans purchased in this section. We will ask about your brewing method to determine the grind size.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 紙のフィルター用でお願いします。この二百グラムの袋を全部挽いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙フィルター粗さと二百グラム全量を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please grind them for a paper filter. Please grind the whole contents of this 200-gram bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify a paper-filter grind and the full 200 grams. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋を開け、こちらの機器でお挽きします。粉を戻す袋は同じ物でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will open the bag and grind the beans with this machine. May we put the grounds back in the same bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 同じ袋で大丈夫です。開けた後に口を閉じられるよう、留める物も付けてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元袋への粉戻しと封口用品を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: The same bag is fine. Could you also provide something to fasten it so I can close it after opening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request returning the grounds to the original bag and something to close it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋を留めるクリップをお付けできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can provide a clip to close the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。豆のままの袋と見分けるため、挽いたことも袋に書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: クリップを希望し挽き済み表記を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, please. Please also write that it has been ground on the bag, so I can distinguish it from bags of whole beans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for the clip and a marking showing the beans have been ground. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 「紙フィルター用」と書きました。挽いた粉をこちらへ戻しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have written “for paper filter.” I have put the ground coffee back in here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 粉になった袋とクリップを受け取りました。この一袋を会計へ持っていき、家では袋の保存表示を読みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 粉袋クリップを受領して購入と保存表示確認を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have received the bag of grounds and the clip. I will take this one bag to checkout, and read the storage instructions on the bag at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm receipt of the grounds and clip, then say you will pay and check the storage instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお会計へお進みください。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed to checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 樹木の案内をご覧になっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the tree information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この名札が二本の木の間にあります。右と左のどちらの名前でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二本の間の名札がどちらの樹木か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: This name label is between two trees. Is it the name of the tree on the right or the left?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which of the two trees the label between them refers to. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 植栽の担当へ確認できます。名札の文字は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can check with the planting staff. Can you read the writing on the label?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「クスノキ」とあります。葉の形が二本で違うので、名札の位置だけでは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 名札文字と葉形差による疑問を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says “camphor tree.” The leaves of the two trees have different shapes, so I cannot tell from the position of the label alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain what the label says and your uncertainty because of the different leaf shapes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 園内の樹木案内もご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can also look at the park's tree guide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内を見たいです。写真には幹も写っているので、この木の特徴と比べられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 幹写真の案内を見て特徴を比べたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to see it. The photo includes the trunk, so I can compare it with the features of this tree.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to compare the tree's features with the trunk photo in the guide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの写真の木は、遊歩道側の一本です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The tree in this photo is the one on the footpath side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 遊歩道側の幹と写真の模様が似ています。反対側の木の名前も、担当が分かれば教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 写真対応を理解しもう一方の樹種も尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: The pattern on the trunk by the footpath looks like the photo. If the staff know, please also tell me the name of the tree on the other side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Acknowledge which tree matches the photo and ask about the other species too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 反対側も含めて確認します。名札は動かさずお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check both, including the one on the other side. Please wait without moving the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: そのままにします。二本と名札が一緒に写る写真を撮って、返事のときに場所を説明できるようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名札を保持し位置説明用の二本写真を撮る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will leave it as it is. I will take a photo showing both trees and the label together, so I can explain the location when I receive the answer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will leave the label in place and photograph both trees to explain the location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ照会します。樹木案内をお持ちになって散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will ask the staff. Please take the tree guide and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今発車した列車についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about the train that has just departed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 網棚へ傘を置いたまま降りました。先ほど出た列車の三号車です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発車済列車三号車の網棚に傘を置いたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I got off leaving my umbrella on the overhead rack. It was in car three of the train that just left.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report leaving an umbrella on the rack in car three of the departed train. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの駅から乗り、何時ごろ降りましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: At which station did you board, and around what time did you get off?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 九時二十分ごろここで降りました。乗ったのは始発の駅です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 降車時刻と乗車駅を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I got off here at about 9:20. I boarded at the first station on the route.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your alighting time and boarding station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 傘の色や、座っていた場所は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Can you describe the umbrella's color and where you were sitting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紺色で、持ち手に黄色いひもがあります。進行方向の右側の席の上です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 傘識別特徴と網棚位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is navy blue, with a yellow cord on the handle. It is above the seats on the right in the direction of travel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the umbrella's identifying features and rack location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 車内の確認を手配します。列車の到着先で見つかる場合もあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will arrange a check inside the train. It may also be found at the train's destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。急いで追いかける列車へ乗るより、ここで受取りの案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 車内確認と現駅での受取り案内を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please check. Rather than rushing onto another train to chase it, I would like to hear how to collect it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request a check of the train and collection information at your current station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかった場合の受取り先と連絡方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the collection location and contact method if it is found.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 電話番号をこの用紙へ書きます。三号車、紺の傘、黄色いひもで伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を記入し車両と特徴をまとめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write my phone number on this form. Please describe it as car three, a navy umbrella, and a yellow cord.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Write your contact details and summarize the car number and distinguishing features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。確認の結果をお知らせします。それでは、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will let you know the result of the check. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 投票の案内をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for voting information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 投票日は仕事です。期日前投票へ行きたいですが、この二か所は受付時間が同じですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 投票日就労による期日前投票と二会場時間差を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have work on election day. I would like to vote early, but do these two locations have the same opening hours?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about early voting because of work on election day and differing hours at two locations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内の一覧で、会場ごとの時間をご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can see the opening hours for each location in the information list.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅近くの会場は夕方まで、市役所は夜までですね。仕事の後なら市役所へ来られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一覧から仕事後に行ける市役所を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The location near the station is open until evening, and city hall until night, correct? I can come to city hall after work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Use the list to choose city hall, where you can go after work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 日にちもご確認ください。会場ごとに開設期間が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check the dates as well. The operating periods differ by location.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 時間だけを見ていました。仕事が早く終わる金曜に、開いている方へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 期間も踏まえ早上がり金曜の利用を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was only looking at the hours. I would like to go to whichever is open on Friday, when I finish work early.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Considering the operating dates too, ask to go on Friday when you finish early. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 金曜はこちらの一覧の期間に入っています。必要な確認は選挙の担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Friday falls within the period in this list. The election staff will explain any necessary checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 届いた案内を持って来ます。建物に入ったら、普段の窓口とは違う入口でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 届いた案内持参と会場入口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will bring the information I received. Once inside the building, is the entrance different from the usual service counters?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will bring the information you received and ask about the polling-place entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 投票会場への矢印が出ます。通常の窓口番号札は使いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Arrows will show the way to the polling place. You will not use the usual numbered counter tickets.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 矢印に沿って会場へ行きます。金曜の終了時刻も手帳へ書いて、時間に間に合うよう来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 矢印利用と金曜終了時刻の記録を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will follow the arrows to the polling place. I will also write Friday's closing time in my diary and arrive in time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will follow the arrows and note Friday's closing time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、この案内をお持ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this information, then. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食事の準備で、お手伝いが必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need help preparing for your meal?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 指に力が入りにくく、この細いスプーンを握ると落としそうです。持ち手の太い物を使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指の力による細柄スプーン保持困難と太柄利用を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have difficulty putting strength into my fingers, and I feel I might drop this spoon with its thin handle. Could I use one with a thicker handle?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss trouble gripping a thin-handled spoon because of weak fingers and ask for a thick-handled one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 使いやすい食具を担当と確認します。どちらの手で使いますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check with the person in charge about suitable utensils. Which hand will you use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右手です。食べ物を載せる前に、空のスプーンで握り方を見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右手使用と空食具で握り確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: My right hand. I would like someone to check my grip with an empty spoon before I put food on it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify your right hand and request a grip check with an empty utensil. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当が確認しました。こちらの太い持ち手をお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge has checked. Please try this thick handle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 握れました。手の中で回らずに持てますが、少し重く感じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 太柄で保持できたが重いと試用結果を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can grip it. It does not turn in my hand, but it feels a little heavy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you can hold the thick handle, but it feels heavy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 別の軽い物もございます。お持ち比べいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is another, lighter one. You can compare how they feel in your hand.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 軽い方なら持ち上げやすいです。今日はこの方を使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 軽い候補の持上げやすさから選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The lighter one is easier to lift. I would like to use this one today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose the lighter option because it is easier to lift. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 食べる時の姿勢と動きも担当が確認します。使った後は食器と一緒にお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will also check your posture and movements when eating. Please return it with the dishes after use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 軽いスプーンを選びました。担当と姿勢を確認してから使い、食後はトレーに戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当の姿勢確認後に使用し食後トレー返却を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have chosen the lighter spoon. I will use it after checking my posture with the person in charge, and return it to the tray after the meal.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will use it after the posture check and return it to the tray after eating. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、食事の準備を続けます。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will continue preparing your meal, then. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お店での出来事ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did something happen at your shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が経営する店の前の鉢が倒れていました。防犯カメラに映っているかもしれないので、映像の扱いを相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 店舗前の鉢転倒とカメラ映像相談を申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: A plant pot in front of the shop I run had fallen over. It may have been captured by the security camera, so I would like advice on handling the footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a fallen pot outside your shop and ask for advice about camera footage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: いつから、いつの間の出来事だと考えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Between what times do you think it happened?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨夜九時に閉店したときは立っていて、今朝八時に見たら倒れていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 無転倒確認時刻と発見時刻を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was standing when I closed at nine last night, but when I looked at eight this morning it had fallen over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State when you last saw the pot standing and when you discovered it fallen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 映像が上書きされる時期は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know when the footage will be overwritten?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 機器の説明書には七日とあります。まだ映像を取り出していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明書の保存期間と未抽出を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The equipment manual says seven days. I have not extracted the footage yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the retention period in the manual and that the footage has not yet been extracted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録の保存方法は機器の担当へも確認してください。状況の聞取りはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also ask the equipment's support staff how to preserve the recording. We can take an account of the circumstances.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まず元の映像を残す相談をします。鉢の写真も撮ったので、今の状態をご覧いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 元映像保存相談及び現状写真提示を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will first ask about keeping the original footage. I also took photos of the pot; could you look at its current condition?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about preserving the original footage and showing photos of the current condition. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を拝見します。被害の状況も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me look at the photos. I will also ask about the damage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 鉢の縁が欠けています。閉店から開店までの間としてお伝えし、倒した人については映像を確認してから話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 鉢欠損と時刻幅を述べ人物は映像確認後に話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: The rim of the pot is chipped. I will describe the time as between closing and opening, and discuss who knocked it over after checking the footage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe the chipped pot and time window, and say you will discuss the person after viewing the footage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承りました。状況を順に伺いますので、失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will ask about the circumstances in order. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have some postcards with you, I see.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 使っていない古い葉書が十枚あります。今は封筒を送りたいので、切手へ交換できるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未使用旧葉書十枚を封筒用切手に交換できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have ten old unused postcards. I want to send an envelope now, so I would like to know whether I can exchange them for stamps.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to exchange ten old unused postcards for stamps to mail an envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書込みや汚れの状態を拝見します。すべて同じ額面ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check for writing and dirt. Are they all the same face value?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じです。住所も本文も書いていません。束の一枚だけ少し角が曲がっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同額面無記入と一枚角曲がりを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I have written neither addresses nor messages. Only one in the stack has a slightly bent corner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that they have the same face value, are blank, and one has a bent corner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 十枚とも交換の対象です。手数料を差し引いた分を切手へ交換できます。まず封筒の料金を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: All ten are eligible for exchange. Their value after deducting the fee can be exchanged for stamps. First, I will check the postage for the envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この封筒一通に使う分です。先に封筒を量って、必要な額を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 持参封筒を計量し必要料金を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: They are for this one envelope. Please weigh it first and tell me the amount needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for your envelope to be weighed and the required postage calculated. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この封筒の料金は百十円です。交換する額の範囲に収まります。残りも切手でお受取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The postage for this envelope is 110 yen. That is within the amount you can exchange. Would you like the remainder in stamps as well?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。この封筒用の百十円を一枚、残りは細かい額面で組み合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒用百十円一枚と残額の小額面切手を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. One 110-yen stamp for this envelope, and please combine smaller denominations for the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request one 110-yen stamp for the envelope and smaller denominations for the remainder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 内訳はこちらです。百十円一枚と、残額分の切手をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Here is the breakdown. I will give you one 110-yen stamp and stamps for the remaining value.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手数料と内訳を確認しました。百十円を今日の封筒へ貼り、残りの切手は袋へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手数料内訳を確認し本日封筒へ貼り残切手を保存する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the fee and breakdown. I will put the 110-yen stamp on today's envelope and place the remaining stamps in a bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the fee and breakdown, then say you will stamp today's envelope and store the rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 交換のお控えもどうぞ。封筒はこちらでお預かりします。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27220-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your exchange receipt too. We will take the envelope here. Thank you.
